name: shared-helper-consumers
goal: List a helper only when at least two distinct services, components or functions use that exact helper at the selected commit.

evidence: Shared means the exact exported helper is used by at least two distinct active components, services or named functions. Repeated calls, type references, unused imports and barrels do not add consumers.

Previous source-shape coverage distinguished callable exports but deliberately allowed no users. Extend its existing matrix with actual references, aliases, namespaces, shadowing, forwarding, mixed consumer kinds and selected-revision removal; catalog/browser fixtures include zero- and one-consumer helpers.
